facts.text: DartCartPole-v0 is registered with entry point gym_dart.envs:DartCartPoleEnv, max_episode_steps=200 and reward_threshold=195.0

The observation space is Box(-high, high) with high = [x_threshold * 2, float32 max, theta_threshold_radians * 2, float32 max], where x_threshold is 2.4 and theta_threshold_radians is 12 degrees in radians
The action space is a one-element Box from -5 to 5 with dtype float32
The world timestep is set to 0.01 s and gravity to (0, 0, -9.8) after the skeleton is loaded
get_state returns [pole angle, pole angular velocity, cart position, cart velocity]
The initial state limits are +-0.1 in all four dimensions
The public reset takes no seed and returns only the observation (no info dict)
reset draws the four state values uniformly from the initial state limits and applies them to the cart and pole positions and velocities
The reset draw uses numpy's global np.random.uniform
step sets the cart velocity to the action, clipped into the action-space bounds, and advances the world one timestep
step returns the legacy 3-tuple (observation, reward, done), not the gymnasium 5-tuple
The episode is done when the absolute pole angle exceeds theta_threshold_radians, the absolute cart position exceeds 1.0, or current_step reaches max_time_steps
The reward is (theta_threshold - |pole angle|) / theta_threshold + exp(-cart position) while the angle is below theta_threshold, otherwise 0.0

determinism.notes: the packaged fake reseeds its own uniform draw from reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1, and its dynamics are deterministic, so one seed plus one action sequence repeats a trajectory; the upstream reset() has no seed parameter and draws from numpy's global random state (dart_cartpole_env.py:129-139), so the sim path cannot repeat a trajectory from a seed

gaps: the packaged fake is a pure-Python stand-in: one damped pendulum equation plus the cart velocity the action sets, with no cart-pole inertia coupling, contact, friction, actuator or sensor model; it is not DART and was never compared with the upstream environment (dartpy is not installed here)

no contact or actuator fidelity: the action directly sets the cart velocity as the upstream step does (dart_cartpole_env.py:162-163), so there is no motor, gearbox, track friction or measurement noise

the upstream class returns the legacy 3-tuple from step() (dart_cartpole_env.py:74-80) and its reset() takes no seed (dart_cartpole_env.py:70-72); the gymnasium bridge requires the 5-tuple and passes seed=..., so the upstream environment cannot be served on the sim backend as committed. The fake returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info) and accepts reset(seed, options)
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state

the fake applies the registration's 200-step truncation itself (gym_dart/__init__.py:12); the upstream step() only stops at its internal 10000-step limit (dart_cartpole_env.py:40), because the TimeLimit wrapper is what gymnasium.make adds
the fake accepts and ignores reset options; the upstream reset() has no options parameter

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
